```yaml
name: Database Export

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "0 0 * * 0"  # Weekly on Sunday at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  export-database:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "24"
          cache: "pnpm"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Setup database export directory
        run: mkdir -p database-export

      - name: Export sanitized database
        run: |
          # Create a sanitized copy of the database
          cp ./data/bookhive.db ./database-export/bookhive-sanitized.db
          
          # Remove sensitive data and reduce size
          sqlite3 ./database-export/bookhive-sanitized.db <<EOF
          PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;
          BEGIN TRANSACTION;
          
          -- Remove user session data
          DELETE FROM sessions;
          
          -- Remove user-specific data that isn't needed for backup
          DELETE FROM user_profiles WHERE username NOT IN ('admin', 'moderator');
          
          -- Remove private book data
          DELETE FROM books WHERE is_private = 1;
          
          -- Remove comments from private books
          DELETE FROM comments WHERE book_id IN (SELECT id FROM books WHERE is_private = 1);
          
          -- Remove user activity logs
          DELETE FROM user_activities;
          
          COMMIT;
          PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON;
          EOF

      - name: Compress database
        run: |
          cd database-export
          zip -r bookhive-backup.zip bookhive-sanitized.db

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: database-backup-${{ github.sha }}
          path: database-export/bookhive-backup.zip
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Cleanup
        if: always()
        run: rm -rf database-export
```
